summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to the transfer agreement related to its pending business combination with Boost Run Inc. The Sponsor agreed to sell 27.5% of founder shares and warrants to an SPV at $1.75 per founder share, with payment deferred up to six months post-close. A shareholder meeting is set for April 30, 2026, to approve the deal. The filing updates mechanics around the lock-up and registration timeline. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential redemptions, which could affect trust balance and deal viability.
